next_step: Finalize POC SOW + sign NDA for on-prem vector DB access
notes:
Overview: ScoutCraft builds an IDE-first developer assistant that is repo-aware across customers' mono-repos. CTO (R. Patel) is focused on latency and determinism — must be under 200ms from keystroke to first token on average for completion flows.

Key technical facts: mono-repo footprint ~25M LOC, ~420k files. Want embeddings + vector DB for retrieval; prefer chunking by function/comment block with overlap for context. Interested in local vector DB options (Milvus/Weaviate) behind VPC or fully on-prem agent.

Model & infra preferences: pin to specific model versions for reproducibility (model pinning + rollout). Prefer quantized open models for offline inference (70B Q4) with fallback to smaller cheaper variants for non-critical routes. Streaming must be low-latency for IDE integration (incremental token stream <50ms first-byte), also want token-level cost breakdown in console.

Security & compliance: SSO/SAML mandatory, audit logging and retention controls required, KMS integration for key management. Some enterprise customers require EU-only residency for source code; ScoutCraft needs a deployment pattern that supports per-customer residency constraints.

Quote from call: "We need completions to feel instant — even if we have to trade off context size aggressively." — R. Patel, CTO.

POC scope summary: ingest subset (5 repos, 2M LOC) -> build embeddings, evaluate retrieval precision@5 and latency (p95 retrieval + serve) -> integrate streaming completions in VS Code plugin and measure end-to-end time. POC success metrics: retrieval p@5 > 0.85 on curated prompts, end-to-end median <180ms for single-file completions, ingestion throughput >= 10k docs/hour for initial bulk.

Notes on concerns: vector DB cold-start time (disk-backed indexes) and snapshot/export for air-gapped installs; how Redwood handles KV cache across dedicated pools; pricing sensitivity for large embedding refresh cadence.

Sales/ops: AE demo + architecture deep dive completed (02/18). Security questionnaire started (SEC-1198). Requested dedicated PO for POC infra costs.

Behavioral: engineering-first team, wants control plane but also needs ops automation. Open to Redwood Dedicated for predictable SLAs; strong interest in Private for customers with strict residency.

Stated next asks: get draft SOW (POC), sample on-prem connector docs, estimated ingest & serving cost for 2M LOC.
